title: Enter into Italy
intro: Drive from Kamnik to Tronchetto Parking, the only parking location for this Venice stop. Walk to the nearby ACTV vaporetto stop, take Line 2 through the Grand Canal to San Marco Giardinetti, explore St. Mark's Square and Rialto Bridge for around two hours, then board Line 2 at Rialto for the return to Tronchetto. Collect the car at the same garage and continue to Brescia. Allow roughly 3–3.5 hours for the entire Venice visit, subject to boat schedules.

stops.name: Kamnik
stops.description: Leave Kamnik and drive west toward Italy.

stops.name: Tronchetto Parking
stops.description: Park the SUV here and walk to the Tronchetto vaporetto stop.

stops.name: Tronchetto Vaporetto Stop
stops.description: Board ACTV Line 2 toward San Marco via the Grand Canal; check the current service and direction.

stops.name: San Marco Giardinetti Vaporetto Stop
stops.description: Disembark at San Marco Giardinetti and walk a short distance to St. Mark's Square.

stops.name: St. Mark's Square
stops.description: See Piazza San Marco and the waterfront, then explore toward Rialto.

stops.name: Rialto Bridge & Grand Canal
stops.description: Enjoy the iconic bridge, photos and a quick coffee.

stops.name: Rialto Vaporetto Stop
stops.description: Board Line 2 toward Piazzale Roma and Tronchetto; check direction and schedule.

stops.name: Tronchetto Vaporetto Stop
stops.description: Disembark at Tronchetto and walk back to the same parking garage.

stops.name: Tronchetto Parking

stops.name: Brescia
